confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese island-resort pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and assume July rainy-season pricing. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, since direct knowledge of Phu Quoc bar prices is weak. The FX observation was taken from search-result text attributing 0.6955 to the RBA's 15 October 2026 4.00pm rate. I did not verify that figure against the RBA table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Vietnamese coastal resort towns such as Nha Trang and Da Nang, adjusted upward for Phu Quoc's island premium on imported goods, transport, and resort accommodation.
